features.label: Breadth
features.gloss: One artifact covers many agendas or problem clusters, not one lineage.

features.label: Long-form argument
features.gloss: A readable through-line (book, sequence, survey) with a thesis.

features.label: Formalization
features.gloss: Mathematical or machine-checked structure for claims or specs.

features.label: Translation
features.gloss: Maps other field programs into its terms without pretending to absorb them.

features.label: Public knowledge site
features.gloss: A maintained web layer (wiki, cards, paths), not only PDFs and posts.

features.label: Constructive theory
features.gloss: A way to build or guarantee — agent theory, training recipe, or spec stack.

features.label: Ships a usable product
features.gloss: Something a user or lab can run or buy today, even if alignment is unsolved.

features.label: Communal
features.gloss: A skeleton others are invited to fill; authorship is not one lab.
